summary: Electronic Warfare Warning Set, part of the F-15's Tactical Electronic Warfare System (TEWS)

sensitivity_dbm.note: Unpublished minimum detectable pulse power at antenna port; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set class bound (Adamy EW 101/102)

antenna_gain_dbi.note: Unpublished ESM/RWR receive antenna gain; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set class estimate

frequency_min_hz.note: Unpublished exact lower RF intercept frequency; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set class band

frequency_max_hz.note: Unpublished exact upper RF intercept frequency; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set class band (standard 2-18 GHz threat band or wider)

bearing_sigma_deg.note: Unpublished 1-sigma AOA error at threshold; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set (4-quadrant amplitude-comparison DF)

bearing_floor_deg.note: Unpublished high-SNR AOA error floor; F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set

measure_s.note: Nominal ESM emitter bearing measurement update interval

memory_s.note: Emitter track coast memory after last intercepted dwell

geolocation.note: Moving-baseline/interferometric emitter geolocation capability (F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set)

comint.note: L-band/VHF-UHF communications/datalink intercept capability (F-15C TEWS Electronic Warfare Warning Set)
